detailed_descriptions.en: Gather your friends and dive into Abyssus ' fast-paced multiplayer shooting action. Fight through gorgeous hand-crafted levels in a roguelite adventure that will put your tactical skills to the ultimate test. Wield powerful brine-powered weapons and refit them with ancient technologies to gain an edge over your foes. Obtain divine blessings to enhance your firepower with elemental and mystic effects. In a world powered by brine, a rare and powerful substance only found in the deepest fathoms of the sea, your team of daring brinepunk explorers is recruited to claim a massive deposit located beneath the ruins of an ancient civilization. However, your mission becomes a frantic battle for survival when the sunken kingdom’s corrupted inhabitants rise against you. Will you survive to see the surface again, or will the abyss claim your life? In Abyssus , cooperation means survival. Team up with fellow Brinehunters and carefully choose synergic loadouts, skills, suits, and weapon mods. Work together and fight through a merciless roguelite gauntlet, where no run is the same as the last. Wield highly customizable, brine-powered armaments and infuse them with the might of ancient Gods. Master 8 weapons and 45 weapon mods, upgrading your skills and suit as you face the underwater kingdom’s mutated guardians. Run after run, you’ll access more and more upgrades and tactical choices, but firepower alone won’t save you from the denizens of the depths. Mastering Abyssus 's visceral gunplay and fast-paced action will require tactical coordination, positioning skills, and cohesive teamwork. The world of Abyssus is richly atmospheric and steeped in mystery. What untold secrets lie in the sunken kingdom? What gives brine its inexplicable powers? Can we weaponize an anglerfish? The answers lie deep down below… Visceral, fast-paced FPS action, with top-notch weapon feel and combat responsiveness Up to 4-players co-op Roguelite meta progression with advancements, rewards, and unlocks 64 hand-crafted levels, procedurally sequenced to make every run a new experience 8 different weapons customizable with 45 weapon mods Extensive pre-run and in-run character customization options 36 different enemies and four bosses that will put your skills to the challenge … and more content to come after launch!
detailed_descriptions.zh-Hant: 集合你的朋友，投入《深淵之潮》節奏明快的多人射擊戰鬥。在 Roguelite 冒險中勇闖華麗的人手製作關卡，考驗你的戰術技能。駕馭強大的鹽水動力武器，並用遠古的技術進行改裝，得到勝過敵人的優勢。獲取神聖祝福，透過元素和神秘效果增強火力。 在一個以鹽水（一種只存在於海底最深處的稀有強大物質）為動力的世界中，你的深海龐克英勇探險隊獲得招募，以奪取位於遠古文明遺跡下的大量資源。殊不知，當這座水底王國的腐敗居民起來對抗你們時，原本的任務就變成了一場瘋狂的生存之戰。 你會活著回到地面，還是被深淵奪走性命？ 在《深淵之潮》中，合作關乎生死。與其他鹽水獵人合作，仔細選擇協同負載、技能、裝備和武器模組。齊心協力，戰勝無情的 Roguelite 挑戰，每一次冒險都與之前不同。 駕馭可自由設定的鹽水動力武器，並為它們注入遠古神明的力量。運用 8 種武器和 45 種武器模組，升級技能和裝備以面對水底王國的突變守護者。 多次戰鬥後，你將獲得越來越多的升級和戰術選擇，但僅依賴火力並不足以戰勝深淵的居民。要掌握《深淵之潮》的激烈槍戰和快速節奏，需配合戰術協調、定位技巧和團隊合作。 《深淵之潮》迷人的世界充滿了神秘的氛圍。這座水底王國到底隱藏著哪些不為人知的秘密？是什麼賦予鹽水如此不可思議的力量？我們可以將琵琶魚變為武器嗎？答案藏在水底深處⋯ 震撼人心、節奏明快的第一人稱射擊遊戲，具備一流的武器手感和戰鬥反應 最多 4 位玩家合作 Roguelite 元進程，包含升級、獎勵和解鎖 64 個人手製作關卡，按程序排列，讓每次遊玩都有新的體驗 8 種不同武器，可與 45 種武器模組進行設定 豐富的遊玩前和遊玩中角色自訂選項 36 種不同敵人和四種頭目，充分考驗你的技能 ⋯⋯遊戲推出後會加入更多內容！
